readme.name: FEArchitect
readme.tagline: A sandbox for designing Fire Emblem 8 encounters
pitch: **Work in progress.** FEArchitect is an early, personal sandbox for designing FE8 encounters: fight math ported from the decomp, a small tactical grid to play scenarios on, and a reference gallery built from your own ROMs.
It is groundwork, not a finished tool. The long-term goal is editing FE8 maps and scenarios with an MCP server as the authoring assistant; none of that write path exists yet.
readme.note: This project is a work in progress and is not ready to use as a tool. Features are incomplete, data formats change without notice, and nothing here writes to a ROM yet.

features.title: Fight math from the decomp
features.text: Hit, damage, crit and doubling follow the fireemblem8u source, including the 2RN hit model, so a duel previews the way the game would roll it.

features.title: A tactical grid to try scenarios on
features.text: Multi-unit scenarios on a terrain grid, with class-based movement, an aggressive enemy AI and seeded auto play to rerun a fight exactly.

features.title: A reference gallery from your ROMs
features.text: Units, classes, items, portraits, battle animations and chapter maps, imported locally from clean ROMs you supply. Nothing from the games is in this repo.

features.title: One operations layer, three ways in
features.text: The same reads, edits, previews and simulations through a CLI, an MCP server for Claude, or a local Ollama bridge.
